script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying the lights dim before anything else happens adds a sequence the passage does not state.
The passage says the sun will be darkened; it does not say whether the sun pauses.
Saying Jesus goes in the opposite direction treats being darkened as the opposite of burning hotter. The passage does not address the sun’s heat.
Calling it the same sky as the Dorinverse mixes Papa Dorin’s fictional world with the Bible event.
Jesus does not tell people to keep their eyes on the sky in this passage.
Everything is rattling stretches the statement that the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
The identification of Elijah as a prophet who spoke for God to Israel needs a reference outside this passage.
The statement that Son of Man is Jesus’ name for Himself needs a reference, such as Mark 2:10.
Calling the clouds His ride adds a detail the text does not give.
The explanation repeats gather and job without adding much explanation or Papa Dorin’s personality.
The response is generic and repeats the answer without a distinctive Papa Dorin voice.
The claim that Jesus is talking to Israelites is outside the passage and needs a reference.
Saying Jerusalem is on everybody’s mind assigns thoughts the text does not state.
Saying the temple was on the disciples’ minds assigns an unmarked thought to them.
After restating the verse, the explanation only says it is being repeated and is plainly stated. It feels generic rather than like Papa Dorin.
The passage does not say nobody was standing around or that the work was handed out before the master was gone.
The claim about a bag of silver in other teachings needs a Scripture reference.
The key anecdote needs to identify it as the mystery key from the drawer. Saying it never found its door also implies an outcome Papa Dorin does not know.
The statement about lamps going out in another teaching needs a reference, such as Matthew 25:8.
The small group on the Mount of Olives and the four listeners are identified outside this passage, in Mark 13:3, and need a reference.
The reference to the people sitting in front of Jesus draws on Mark 13:3 and needs a reference.
